entities.definition: Saved activation home-battery SoC for maximum solar soak. Start must be strictly above stop. The distinct band avoids repeated max-rate starts around one boundary; original averaged-soak settings remain unchanged.
entities.producer: EvSolarSoakThresholdNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_numbers. Setup/reconfiguration and native edits persist the same configuration-entry setting.
entities.unit_and_sign: Finite percentage, 0 through 100, displayed in 0.1 percentage-point steps; start > stop. Defaults start 95%, stop 90%.
entities.time_basis: Current persisted operator setting; survives restart/reload. Setting edits reconcile the existing EV controller without creating another writer.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded, including a telemetry outage. Editing a setting does not grant hardware authority.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite valid hysteresis band. Invalid native edits are rejected and invalid saved pairs use 100/100 sentinels that cannot grant maximum mode.

entities.definition: Opt-in maximum-current branch of the already-enabled direct post-free solar policy. Defaults off; no independent writer or paid charging override. Existing house reserves, current limits, source qualification and higher owners remain authoritative.
entities.producer: EvSolarSoakMaxSwitch.is_on projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_policy.solar_soak_max_enabled. Setup/reconfiguration and native edits persist the same configuration-entry setting.
